instrument: benchmarks/run_paired_capacity_test.py :: run_paired_condition at max_predictions in 1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000, cycles 0-109, 112 world edges, 2-tag compositional world
limits: Five diagnostic seeds on the amended engine, three on each earlier build at most; 89b0744's cap-20 and cap-1000 cells for its other two seeds are the 2026-10-28 record, and e6d1bcc's cap-1000 cells are the same-day treatment re-run, not new engine runs.
Precision is measured on the final asserted set filtered to the world vocabulary, and is not comparable to the 0.3438 Layer-1 selection-precision ceiling.

One 2-tag compositional world family; no confirmatory seed. The asserted-set size is itself a function of the cap, so recall and precision are read against a moving population rather than a fixed budget.

amendment_drop_at_cap_1.pairing: amended vs e6d1bcc, same seed, cap 1, same 112-edge world

marginal_assertions.question: When capacity buys recall, how accurate are the edges it buys? And when the amendment shrinks the asserted set, what kind of edge does it remove?

question: Is precision flat across the whole capacity curve, or does it step with recall — and does the step belong to the freeze amendment or to an earlier build?

89b0744.recall_shape: late step: nothing by cap 50, nearly all of it by cap 500

amended.recall_shape: spread: the rise is distributed across the cap range

e6d1bcc.recall_shape: spread: the rise is distributed across the cap range
